text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Brown-gold tweed stand-collar jacket and matching gold-button waistcoat, dark brown wide leather Bermuda shorts, brown mid-calf boots.
original_prompt: Edit this product photograph only. Remove the curved gold necklace/chain hanging across the dark open neck area between the two upper jacket lapels. Leave that neck opening plain, completely empty white background, no gold chain or pendant inside the opening. Keep all sewn gold tweed edging, buttons, jacket, waistcoat, brown leather shorts and boots unchanged. No person, skin, mannequin, stand or added objects. Pure white background, preserve layout.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
